articles.text: Miss: May I see the apartment, sir?
Juan: Sí, cómo no, pase adelante.
Juan: Yes, of course, come on in.
Miss: What work is there to do?
Juan: Todo el trabajo de casa. Es decir, barrer los pisos, lavar el baño, hacer las camas....
Juan: All the housework. That is, sweep the floors, wash the bathroom, make the beds....
Miss: Do I have to wash clothes?
Juan: No. La ropa hay que mandarla a la lavandería.
Juan: No. The clothes have to be sent to the laundry.
